<!--
  Universal pull request template.
  Fill in the relevant sections; optional sections may be removed.
  Comments like this one are hidden in the preview.
-->

## Why

<!-- What problem does this change solve? What is the motivation, requirement, or context? Why does it matter? -->

## What was done

<!-- What changes concretely? Key points as a bulleted list, e.g. new functionality, changed workflows, new data fields/migrations. -->

-

## Implementation / Architecture

<!-- Optional: Which technical decisions were made? Which building blocks (classes, modules, configuration, migrations) are affected? -->

## Notes for reviewers

<!-- Assumptions, deliberate deviations from the requirement, open points, limitations of the dev environment, manually checked areas. -->

## Tests / Verification

<!-- How was the change verified? Test results and the commands to reproduce them. If tests could not be run: why not? -->

## Migration / Deployment

<!-- Optional: New migrations, configuration or environment changes, manual steps after merge. Remove if not applicable. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] Title describes the change briefly and precisely
- [ ] Change meets the requirement and is fully implemented
- [ ] Tests added or updated and run
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] Self-review done
